location_note: Pottery report; Crusader-period underground reservoir at Moza (excavation: Mizrahi and Greenhut, 'Atiqot 91, not in this reader's units); no map reference. Placed by the name Moza (gazetteer, Z4).
notes: Ayyubid and Mamluk pottery from fills dumped into the reservoir after it went out of use. Reservoir coded as context (choice C2); probably the same structure as the vaults in ATQ58-135.

features.quote: Excavations of a Crusader-priod underground water reservoir at Moẓa
